Pinus Pengger Guide

Parking at Hutan Pinus Pengger

Parking availability, location and fees at Hutan Pinus Pengger are not verified by this guide. This page gathers how to ask about parking correctly and tips for vehicles in the hill area.

Updated 28 October 2026

Detail

Ask, do not assume

The village page says the access road can take four-wheel vehicles and tourist buses, but the specific parking location and fees are unverified. Ask on-site staff for the parking point, capacity and cost.

Detail

Hill-area parking tips

  • Use a roadworthy vehicle; mind slopes and bends.
  • Park in marked areas; do not block pedestrian paths.
  • Note your vehicle position; night signal and lighting are limited.

Detail

Towards nightfall

If visiting at dusk or night, finish parking before dark and agree on a return ride early.

Frequently asked questions

Is there a parking area at Pinus Pengger?

The presence of a parking area is not independently verified. Ask staff about location and capacity on site, as the parking point may change.

What is the parking fee?

Parking rates are unverified. Ask staff about two-wheel and four-wheel parking fees before leaving your vehicle.

Can a bus or van park there?

Kalurahan Terong's page says the access road can take tourist buses, so parking for large vehicles may be available. Confirm capacity and directions with staff.

Is it safe to leave the vehicle?

Use an official marked parking area and follow staff. This guide cannot guarantee safety; keep valuables and lock the vehicle.
